hypotheses.justification: The theorem takes `[NeZero p]` only because `p` appears in the statement. Nothing in the statement or proof uses it. (1) `modularFunctionFieldFull N` is `IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (divisorExpansions N)`. `divisorExpansions N` is a set defined with an existential over `d` and `[NeZero d]`, never `NeZero N`. The source file states `jqd_mem_full` (which mentions `modularFunctionFieldFull N`) under `omit [NeZero N] in`, and it compiles, so the field needs no `NeZero N`. (2) `coeffEmb L := coeffMap (algebraMap ℚ L)`, `laurentBaseChange L F₀ := IntermediateField.adjoin L (coeffEmb L '' F₀)` and `coeffEmb_mem_laurentBaseChange` have no NeZero argument. (3) `bar` is an `abbrev`. For definitions, Lean drops unused section variables (`removeUnusedVars` / `Meta.removeUnused` in Lean/Elab/MutualDef.lean and Lean/Meta/CollectFVars.lean), and nothing in `bar`'s body uses `[NeZero p]`, so `bar` does not take it. With `omit [NeZero p] in`, the statement still elaborates. The proof `rfl` is unchanged: the coercion of `bar p b = ⟨coeffEmb _ b, _⟩` is `coeffEmb _ b` by definition, for every `p`, including `p = 0`.
